summary: End-to-end testing of GK GS Masti Store completed. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passing (auth, categories, products, sample PDF, wishlist, coupons, order + mock payment + entitlement + PDF download, admin CRUD/analytics/orders/customers, admin authz). Frontend: full customer journey works - homepage renders (search, cart, wishlist, WhatsApp button, hero slider, both category dropdowns with 6 items each, 11 product cards), category page filters, product page shows price+sample PDF modal (iframe loads), register works, add-to-cart, cart summary correct, checkout with WELCOME10 coupon applies 10% off, mock payment modal opens, mock-pay-confirm-btn completes order, order appears in My Orders, PDF appears in My Digital Materials with working Download button. Admin login redirects to /admin, dashboard shows Revenue/Orders/Learners/Pending metrics, all admin pages (products/orders/customers/categories) load with data, and unauthenticated /admin access correctly redirects to /login.

minor.issue: Requires full ProductIn body (title, category_id, price all required). A PATCH-style partial update would be safer/better DX, but current admin UI sends full body so this works.

httpOnly cookie takes priority over Authorization Bearer header. If a browser has an admin cookie and an app sends a user Bearer token, the cookie wins. Not exploitable in practice (single-user browser) but priority should be reversed or one method should be enforced per client.

issues: Dropdown-only-on-hover for Notes/Books - not keyboard/tap friendly on mobile. There's a mobile menu but the desktop hover dropdown has no click fallback.

action_items: Consider supporting partial updates on PUT /api/admin/products (or add PATCH) to avoid resending full product body.
Consider prioritizing Authorization Bearer header over cookie in get_current_user, or documenting the precedence clearly.
Optional: add click-to-open behavior for header category dropdowns for touch/keyboard users.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1110 lines - could be split into routers (auth, products, orders, admin, uploads) for maintainability.

Login lockout resets counter to 0 and sets locked_until after 5th failure - reasonable, but 15-minute lockout uses ISO string comparison via datetime.fromisoformat - works but could use a proper TTL index.
verify_payment does not check that razorpay_order_id matches the mock order id created earlier - in mock mode any payload succeeds. Acceptable since mock, but add a note.
MongoDB _id is consistently excluded via projections - good.
All admin endpoints properly gated with require_admin - good. Verified with test_admin_forbidden_for_user.
test_credentials: Admin palakneuroclinic@gmail.com / Admin@123 works. Created dynamic test users like testuser_<timestamp>@test.com / test123 during tests.
seed_data_creation: Tests create per-run users with timestamp emails and one paid order + entitlement per run. No cleanup needed as they use unique emails. Admin product created in CRUD test is deleted at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full stack works. Reference selectors: nav-dropdown-notes/books, nav-cat-{group}-{slug}, cart-counter-button, wishlist-counter-button, user-menu-button, login-link, hero-slider-prev/next-btn, product-card-N, product-sample-pdf-btn, register-{name|email|mobile|password}-input, register-address-input, register-submit-btn, login-{email|password}-input, login-submit-btn, proceed-checkout-btn, addr-{name|mobile|line1|line2|city|state|pincode}-input, checkout-coupon-input, apply-coupon-btn, mock-payment-modal, mock-pay-confirm-btn, customer-dashboard-tab-{orders|downloads|wishlist|profile}, download-pdf-btn-N, admin-add-product-btn.
